params.body:
Twelve open issues describe findings that are already solved on main. This PR closes them on merge and brings the three finding files that still said `status: open` up to date.

## Findings marked solved here
- X-20, `herinneringen-tijdens-de-toewijstermijn` (#594): solved in #944. `Daily::doAlmostExpiredExports` looks up bids through `ExportVehicle::reminderEndDate()`, an end date in the past inside the assign window.
- X-106, `een-eigen-wagen-toont-in-klantmodus-de` (#606): solved in #774. `CustomerModePrice::documentPrefill` checks for an own vehicle, so the offer modal and the lease row start at the retail price like the order price field.
- X-51, `werklijst-car-pass-telt-mee-in-de` (#646): solved in #885. The worklist mail takes its lines from `WorklistDigest`, with its own Car-Pass line (`email.worklist_mail_line_carpasses`).

## Already marked solved in their finding, issue never closed
#570 and #576 (#688), #580 (#738), #585 (#736), #588 (#689), #601 (#960), #611 (#765), #612 (#663).

## Answered, no change asked
#970: the Car-Pass password field shows a fixed placeholder by design; the issue carries the answer.

Each one was checked against the code on main. Full suite locally: 3029 tests OK (2 skipped, 1 incomplete).

Closes #570
Closes #576
Closes #580
Closes #585
Closes #588
Closes #594
Closes #601

params.title: Close twelve issues whose findings are solved; mark three stale findings solved
